'''2002 Vegas DPC''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG Decipher Player Championship on 12 May 2002 in Las Vegas, Nevada. [[Brian Hunter]] won 5–0 with a [[Light]] [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Plead My Case To The Senate]] list (''LS Senate done RIGHT aka Ghhhks Away'').<ref name="dt-23407">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23407 LS Senate done RIGHT aka Ghhhks Away], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 18 May 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23407/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23407/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009165649/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23407/ Wayback Machine].</ref><ref name="dpc-vegas-tr">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-15-vegas-baby-lush-at-the-vegas-dpcd3660/ vegas-baby-lush-at-the-vegas-dpc], Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, DeckTech (15 May 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-15-vegas-baby-lush-at-the-vegas-dpcd3660/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 12 May 2002
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, Nevada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
